notes.title: HUGE April Update
notes.notes:
Hello, dear players! 

We are pleased to present you with a major update to the game:


 The training system has been completely redesigned. Now, instead of boring videos, you learn interactively and with a pleasant royal adviser.
 Now you can play the game with one hand. All additional functionality (changing the type of arrows, highlighting the trajectory of enemy attacks, canceling the previous action) has been moved to the screen in the form of buttons.
 Consumable item cards have been redesigned into a compact inventory system that takes up less space on the screen.
 Target cells on knight levels are now highlighted, so you will never miss them.
 We have painted the walls of the assembled castles from above, so it is now much easier to determine whether the walls match each other.
 

But that's not all! From May 1 to 14, Rubicon: Cubindom gets a 50% discount in honor of participating in the Games From Russia 2025 festival.

Thank you for playing in Rubicon: Cubindom and have a nice day!
Andrew

notes.title: 4 Feb update
notes.notes:
Hello, dear players! 

We have released a small update that contains the following changes:


The elements of the environment (the mill, houses, haystacks) stopped responding to clicks. Now their behavior is triggered at a random moment in time and nothing else blocks the cube tiles.
Added smooth camera rotation.
Added a camera rotation reset button.
Added deselection of a tile or knight by right-clicking.


Thank you for playing in Rubicon: Cubindom and have a nice day!
Andrew

notes.title: First month update
notes.notes:
Hi everyone, 

We have released an update that slightly changed some game mechanics and added new functionality:

What's added

 Now you can assign which keyboard buttons will be responsible for game actions. Visit the second page in the settings
 A wonderful new background track

What's changed or fixed

 180 degree rotation, now for this you need to hold down the left mouse button on arrow until the scale is filled, and then release. For more details, visit the tutorial videos in the settings
 The cancellation of the action has been redesigned. Now you can cancel your last action after it is completed. Restore the knight's stats after a failed move or return the castle walls to their previous position without penalty to the total number of rotations. It became more like Ctrl+Z
 On some levels, we have changed the required number of rotations to get an additional star
 Fixed a hint that caused the knight to lose health
 Fixed a bug that sometimes caused an adjacent tile to be highlighted when clicking on the arrow
 Fixed some English translation inaccuracies


Thank you for playing in Rubicon: Cubindom and have a nice day!
Andrew
